## Context / observed warning
Tracker writes repeatedly emit:

`WARNING rebar.llm.enrich_drain: enrich drain gate check took 300–500 ms (> 20 ms budget)`

A closed ticket (`verymad-hard-weaverbird`) recorded the same observation at 300–800 ms but explicitly left it separate. No open bug owns this warning. The warning occurs on ordinary write paths where the feature gate is intended to be cheap.

## Investigation and repair protocol
- Use `rebar-debug` in a fresh worktree from current `origin/main`.
- Reproduce the latency with deterministic instrumentation or a bounded measurement that isolates the gate check from unrelated tracker work.
- Build an evidence dossier, propose falsifiable causes, and confirm the runtime mechanism before changing production code.
- Establish defect legitimacy against the documented 20 ms budget and run the caller-dependency gate.
- If a defect is proven and remediation does not require a behavioral/design decision, repair via physically withheld RED-oracle TDD, run the relevant and full gates, send through Gerrit, and close only after both votes are green and the change lands.
- If remediation changes when enrichment runs, its consistency guarantees, or another user-visible behavior, stop with a decision brief for operator approval.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The warning is reproduced and its root cause is proven with runtime evidence and exact citations.
- [ ] The ticket records whether the behavior is a defect against the 20 ms contract or needs an operator decision.
- [ ] For an autonomous defect repair, a mechanism-level regression test is observed RED before the fix, physically withheld from the fixer, GREEN afterward, and shown to fail under a defect-seeded mutation.
- [ ] The original warning scenario is replicated after remediation and meets the documented budget without weakening enrichment correctness.
- [ ] Construct and surface-parity siblings receive explicit dispositions.
- [ ] Any code change passes local gates, Gerrit LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, lands, and only then is the ticket closed.
compiled_state.title: Enrich drain cheap gate exceeds its 20 ms latency budget
